name: Avangaad Berhad
overview: 今年公司完成一艘船舶的出售，交易金额为 USD10,500,000，并已收到全额款项，涉及 Offshore Storage 板块的资产处置。其余板块在公告中未见新增合约、扩张或缩减的具体披露。
overview_en: During the year, the Company completed the sale of a vessel for a total consideration of USD10,500,000, with full payment received, involving an asset disposal in the Offshore Storage segment. No specific disclosures on new contracts, expansion, or reduction were seen for the other segments in the announcements.

segments.name: 离岸存储
segments.note: 今年完成一艘船舶的出售，交易金额为 USD10,500,000，并已收到全额款项。
segments.note_en: Completed the sale of a vessel for USD10,500,000 this year, with full payment received.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司以 USD10,500,000 出售一艘船舶，已收到全额款项，待相关当局签发所有权转移证书后完成。
actions.text_en: The Company sold a vessel for USD10,500,000, received full payment, and completion is pending issuance of the relevant certificate(s) by the authorities to effect ownership transfer.
